summary: The page is a careful development of complete/dense embeddings, name translation, and Boolean-valued models. I checked the proofs of set:generic-criterion, set:complete-embedding-generic, set:dense-embedding-same-extension, set:name-translation-basic, and set:truth-value-basic, plus the examples and problems. All cited results are used consistently with their quoted statements. The side remark about Fn(κ,2) vs Fn(κ,2,ω_1) is mathematically correct. I found no errors, gaps, or circularities worth reporting.
